programme.desc: Having previously been dominated by the Empires of Russia, Germany and Austro-Hungary, many peoples of Eastern Europe had cherished hopes of gaining freedom after World War I.

programme.title: The End of the Ottomanns
programme.desc: At the end of WWI, the Treaty of Versailles and the Treaty of Sèvres stood for a new world order. This is where the victorious powers decided the Ottoman Empire was to be broken up.

programme.title: Gold for Kim - A Life for North Korea's Leader
programme.desc: North Korea is a country of stark contrasts. On the one hand, it presents real socialist stereotypes like cryptic messages from a frozen time loop, combined with shocking reports on shortages. On the other hand, polished Pyongyang lures with a futuristic skyline, flashy amusement parks and department stores with a range of goods equal to those in western consumer meccas.

programme.title: Signs of Evil - The Runes of the SS
programme.desc: The symbol of the SS, Hitler’s Schutzstaffel, stands for terror and the murder of millions. The penniless graphic artist Walter Heck was given the job of designing the jagged, rune-like characters in 1929. The “sig” rune was rooted deep in the ideological cosmos of the Nazis and their supporters. They saw themselves as the descendants of the Teutons and declared the runes to be humanity’s original Germanic script. The symbol was meant to unite Heinrich Himmler’s “Black Order.” But did it escape their notice that it was originally of Semitic origin? In October 1945, the Allies passed a law banning the Nazi Party and all associated organizations, including the SS. The young Federal Republic even forbade all Nazi symbols. This documentary tells the gripping story of the SS symbol, from the Middle Ages to the present day.

programme.title: Mata Hari - The Beautiful Spy
programme.desc: In February 1917 World War I is raging when Mata Hari is arrested in Paris and taken to the examining magistrate. Her very life is at stake: she is accused of high treason. The famous exotic dancer has come to represent beauty and the power of feminine seduction. The documentary Mata Hari - the Beautiful Spy tracks down the true story of this fascinating woman.

programme.title: The Child Crusades - Barefoot to the Promised Land
programme.desc: In Cologne in 1212 a boy named Nicholas captivated thousands of children between the ages of eight and fifteen with his fanatical speeches. They had been chosen, he said, to liberate Jerusalem. Likewise, in the French town of Cloyes a young shepherd gathered numerous children around him with the same proclamation.

programme.title: Forest of Heroes
programme.desc: From Lower Saxony and North Rhine Westphalia, from Osnabrück to Paderborn, one of Germany’s most beautiful forests extends for some 150 kilometers - the Teutoburg Forest. The low mountain range became famous due to the Varus Battle that took place in 9 AD. It was here that Hermann, or Arminius, the Cherusci Prince vanquished the Roman occupation army.

programme.title: The Battle for the Baltic Sea
programme.desc: It’s in spring 2008, when the telephone of the Archaeological State Office Schleswig-Holstein suddenly rings. The message archeologist Martin Segschneider receives makes him curious.

programme.title: Operation Peter Pan - The Secret War against Cuba
programme.desc: In 2016, a historic moment arrived when Barack Obama spoke in Cuba to the inhabitants of the island nation and promised a future together. For the first time in more than 50 years, an American president had entered the communist country and turned towards an erstwhile enemy. However, the US economic embargo against Cuba continues. It sanctions the socialist state – although the UN General Assembly recently again called it a violation of international law. Many Cubans are therefore sceptical about a new political future, despite the friendly words of the American President. Their distrust is deep. It is based on over fifty years of history and the policies of the United States towards their country. For years, the Cuban government has raised serious allegations against their big neighbour. The film "Operation Peter Pan" tracks these allegations.

programme.title: Monsters and Myths
programme.desc: Monsters have always been part of our nightmares and fairy tales. But where do they actually come from? How much of them is truth, how much is myth? Going to great lengths in this documentary, the filmmakers join scientists to explore a number of the best known sagas and legends in the world.

programme.title: World War A - When Aliens Attack
programme.desc: Scientists are already looking feverishly for evidence of extraterrestrial life. With the ExoMars mission, ESA will soon find life on Mars. If there are only tiny microbes, there could also be life in other places in the universe. But can life in space exist at all? The exobiologist Jean-Pierre de Vera collects microorganisms around the world and tests them in his Mars simulation laboratory. Can they survive under the deadly conditions of Mars? Researchers believe there are planets on which alien life can exist. In 1991 the Swiss astrophysicist Michel Mayor discovered the world's first exoplanet. Since then, about 3,000 planets have been detected outside our solar system. Heike Rauer from the German Aerospace Center is looking for habitable planets. Will she find a second earth? The European Southern Observatory is also searching for life in space, building the largest telescope in the world. In the next 20 years the E-ELT should be able to prove the existence of life on distant planets. How would extraterrestrials look? Some scientists suspect that they may well resemble us humans. Under other environmental conditions, alien life could also arise completely differently. It could be formed from methane and silicon. Different gravity would form alien bodies completely differently. Could extraterrestrials send us messages? At the SETI Institute in California, alien hunters like Seth Shostak are listening to signals from alien civilizations. But mere listening is no longer enough. Some SETI researchers now want to send messages to the aliens themselves. They hope to finally get an answer. But would that be a bad idea? Many scientists warn of the dangers of establishing contact. The former SETI researcher and science fiction author David Brin also fears that it could be a devastating mistake. With well-meant news we could end up attracting attention from hostile civilizations. Should we really tell them that we exist and where they can find us?

programme.title: UFOs and the Cold War
programme.desc: Pop culture is unthinkable without them, and so is the Cold War: UFO’s, those flying saucers allegedly bringing aliens to dominate the world.

programme.title: The Balkans in Flames

programme.title: Hannibal: A March on Rome

programme.title: Crime Scene Eulau - The Mystery of the 13 Skeletons
programme.desc: This documentary focuses on a spectacular discovery made in a quarry near the village of Eulau, not far from the central German town of Naumburg. Neolithic graves contained the skeletons of three women, two men and eight children, buried tenderly 4500 years ago, some affectionately entwined. In 2008, for the first time anywhere in the world, it was possible to perform a DNA analysis on the earliest evidence of the existence of a nuclear family. This was a sensation - but why did these people all die at the same time? Were they the victims of a violent crime? Who were they, and how did this terrible drama unfold? Archaeologists insist that these victims will not be forgotten, since these days it is possible to do far more than simply date and record such finds. Modern scientific methods have revolutionised archaeology, enabling us to discover how and why the family from Eulau in the German state of Sachsen-Anhalt died 4500 years ago. By enlisting the help of a CID profiler, archaeologists and anthropologists employ state-of-the-art analytical methods to investigate this Stone Age crime. In the process we discover key information about an era before recorded history which has previously been shrouded in mystery - and astonishing information about the composition of the population here also comes to light. It seems that the third millennium before Christ saw two major waves of migration, from Eastern and Western Europe, which determine the composition of the population here. In the middle of what is now Germany these two migratory movements met. Could this be the background to the mysterious murders of Eulau?

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E02 - Blue Mind (Part 1)
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health? Guided by Dr. Wallace J. Nichols, author of "The Blue Mind," we delve into the scientific and emotional benefits of water, exemplified by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection to aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we uncover how New Zealand's abundant waters serve as more than just a natural spectacle; they are a source of holistic health and well-being. Along the way, Dr. Nichols introduces the concept of a "bluescription," a personalized prescription for water-based activities, inviting viewers to tap into the transformative power of water in their own lives.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E08 - The Purpose of life Pt 1
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked with all five senses? Join us on a journey from the bustling metropolis of Tokyo to the serene Okutama forest to meet Dr. Kagawa, the pioneering scientist who first validated the health benefits of nature immersion. Together, we engage in Shinrin Yoku, commonly known as forest bathing, a sensory-rich experience that invites us to use all five senses as we explore the wooded landscape. This episode reveals that forest bathing is far more than just a nature hike; it's a practice of mindfulness that fully immerses us in the present moment through sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste. Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature. Join us on this eye-opening expedition and discover how you, too, can improve your well-being through the simple yet transformative act of forest bathing.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E09 - Purpose Of Life (Part 2)
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of "moai," a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of "Hara Hachi Bu," which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find "ikigai"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your own quest for a long and fulfilling life.

programme.desc: After witnessing agricultural practices in far-flung places like Bhutan and Okinawa, host Mike dives into the world of sustainable gardening right in his own backyard. With the guidance of a local soil scientist, we follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably. From planting the first seeds to navigating unexpected challenges, this episode offers a candid look at the highs and lows of gardening for sustainability. Beyond the physical labor and the harvest, we also explore the emotional and mental rewards of this earthy endeavor. Mike learns that the act of growing your own food is not just a means to an end—it's a therapeutic practice that nurtures the mind as well as the body. Tune in to see how the simple act of cultivating a garden can yield abundant lessons in sustainability, health, and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.sub-title: Health Explored S01 E12 - Behind Season 1
programme.desc: We embark on a unique journey around the world to film our series but behind the scenes explore the effects of stress on the human body. Equipped with cutting-edge Hexo Skin sensors and other wearable tech, we subject ourselves to adrenaline-pumping activities like skydiving and roller coaster rides, as well as draining experiences like red-eye flights. By monitoring real-time data, we gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses. From heart rate fluctuations to sleep monitoring this episode reveals how stress can be both an exhilarating and exhausting experience. As we push the limits of adventure—and our own comfort zones—we discover that creating a health series can be a surprisingly stressful endeavor in itself. Tune in to uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being and learn what we can do to manage it effectively.

Diamond gets word, from her trusted sources, that two members of the crew are plotting to overthrow her Father’s drug empire. Diamond must get rid of the two disloyal members of the crew before they take control of the operation.

programme.title: VW Transporter auf Ford-Basis | Endlich wieder Platz im Bulli? | Motorvision
programme.desc: Ist er der einzig wahre „VW-Bus“? Nachdem ID.Buzz und Multivan einiges an Platz einbüßen mussten, schickt Volkswagen den Transporter und Caravelle hinterher, mit mehr Stauraum und Nutzwert.

programme.title: VW Bulli speckt 200kg ab | Erste Fahrt im Volkswagen T7 (2021)
programme.desc: Eine Ikone erfindet sich neu. Der VW Bus wird in siebter Generation komplett überarbeitet. Kein Baustein bleibt mehr auf dem anderen. Neue Antriebe, neue Assistenten und neue Gimmicks sollen den Lifestyle-Faktor noch einmal erhöhen. Wie gut gelingt der Wandel?

programme.title: Stärkster Bulli aller Zeiten mit Platz für 7: Wir testen den VW ID. Buzz GTX mit langem Radstand
programme.desc: VW bringt den stärksten Serien-Bulli aller Zeiten! Der ID. Buzz kommt als GTX-Version und mit bis zu sieben Sitzen. Wir testen, was der sportliche Retro-Elektro-Bus dynamisch wirklich drauf hat.

programme.title: VW ID. Buzz | Wie viel Bulli-Spirit steckt im vollelektrischen VW Bus?
programme.desc: Der VW Bus ist eine automobile Ikone und begeistert seit über 70 Jahren Autofans rund um den Globus. Mit dem vollelektrischen ID. Buzz bricht für ihn eine neue Ära an. Wie fährt er sich und wie finden ihn die Menschen? Wir testen ihn in Kopenhagen.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Das Bulli Summer Festival ist eines der weltweit größten Treffen für Fans und BesitzerInnen des VW Bulli. Um den 70. Geburtstag des T1 zu feiern, trafen sich 1200 Bulli-Besitzer im Aller Park in Wolfsburg.

programme.title: Faszination Mercedes S-Klasse: Wir fahren alle Baureihen vom 450 SEL 6.9 bis zum S 580 e!
programme.desc: Die Mercedes S-Klasse steht seit 7 Generationen für Komfort, Luxus und herausragende Technologie wie keine andere Limousine. Wir fahren alle Baureihen, vom 450 SEL 6.9 bis zum aktuellen S 580 e und ergründen die Faszination jedes Modells.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Was passiert mit der Reichweite von Elektroautos, wenn Stereoanlage und Heizung im Dauerbetrieb sind? Wir haben den VW e-up! und Renault's Zoe im Alltag getestet. Außerdem: Opels Ampera. Und: der BMW i3, die bayerische Elektro-Fließhecklimousine.

programme.title: Aston Martin DB11 mit V8 von AMG
programme.desc: Sie gilt als coolste Automarke der Welt und verkörpert einen ganz besonderen Lifestyle. Ein Merkmal ist dem britischen Traditionsunternehmen besonders wichtig: Eleganz! Der schönste Wagen am Platze, der mit dem größten Sexappeal, das ist: Aston Martin. Beim Sound haben die Briten höchste Ansprüche und setzen ab jetzt - neben ihren V12-Motoren - auch auf klangvolle V8 von AMG.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Chevrolet Chevelle und Down Town Garage
programme.desc: Kati und Patrick aus München sind absolute US-Car-Fans und stolze Besitzer einer 72er Chevrolet Chevelle. Doch der 5,7 Liter Small Block reicht den beiden nicht mehr: Ein größerer Motor soll her. Deshalb geht's zu den Jungs von Down Town Garage in Berlin. Bei den Motorspezialisten lagern über 50 Aggregate ¿ von leistungsstarken Strokern bis hin zu seltenen Flatheads. Außerdem gehört zur Location ein American Diner mit Motel.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.sub-title: Oldtimer Show and Race at Airport
programme.desc: Kati und Patrick aus München sind absolute US-Car Fans und stolze Besitzer einer 72er Chevrolet Chevelle. US-Car Spezialist Frank Slopianka von Special Cars Berlin hat das seltene Stück aufgestöbert und restauriert. In Paaren / Glien bei Berlin treffen sie Frank auf der alljährlichen Oldtimer Show, die bei über 5.000 Fahrzeugexponaten um die 45.000 Zuschauer anlockt.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: The bigger, the better! Das ist das Motto auf der größten und bekanntesten Tuning-Messe der Welt - der SEMA Show in Las Vegas. Über 150.000 Automobilbegeisterte pilgern jedes Jahr in die Wüste Nevadas, um sich dieses Spektakel nicht entgehen zu lassen. Darunter auch Motorjournalistin Kati. Zusammen mit Tuning-Experte Dirk Hattenhauer macht sie sich auf die Suchen nach den verrücktesten Trends. Dirk kennt sich auf der SEMA bestens aus und hat jede Menge Promis aus der Szene an der Hand, wie den berühmten Customizer John D¿Agostino oder Drift-Star Ken Block.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Die SEMA in Las Vegas ist die größte und bekannteste Tuning-Messe der Welt. Von aufwändig umgebauten Show-Cars bis zu riesigen Offroad-Monster-Trucks ist hier alles vertreten. Die Autos stehen nicht nur rum: Beim legendären Cruise fährt alles vor, was die Szene hergibt und auf der berühmten After-Show-Party 'SEMA Ignited' wird richtig Gummi gegeben!

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Die Nürburgring Nordschleife gilt als die härteste Rennstrecke der Welt. Gemeinsam mit dem Rennfahrer Hans-Joachim Stuck werfen wir einen Blick auf die Geschichte dieser Rennstrecke und die Veranstaltungen und Rekordversuche dort.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Was sind die Merkmale eines typischen deutschen Autos? Zeichnen Klischees wie Funktionalität, Zuverlässigkeit, aber auch eine gewisse Langweiligkeit ein realistisches Bild? Außerdem: bringt der VW Golf GTE neue Impulse in die Modellpalette der Marke?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Rutschige oder matschige Straßen und schlechte Sicht sind Umstände, die den Fahrspaß im Winter oft trüben. Wir nehmen zwei fast identische Porsche 911er auf eine vereiste Teststrecke mit. Außerdem: Driftspaß im Schnee mit dem Suzuki SX4 S-Cross.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: 4-türige Coupés vereinen das Beste aus zwei Welten: die Performance eines Coupés und die Klasse einer Limousine. Wir haben drei Exemplare unter die Lupe genommen: den Audi A7, BMWs 4er Gran Coupé und die CLA-Modelle von Mercedes-Benz.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: O entusiasta de carros Walter Schlüter teve seu BMW 328 regular modificado para fins de corrida. Além disso: o TVR 3000M Cosworth faz até mesmo os pilotos da Porsche terem inveja. E: Um Opel Kapitän de 60 anos está sendo reformado.

programme.title: Kias Kompaktoffensive: Wir testen das neue Sportage Facelift und checken weiter Modelle!

programme.title: Classic Ride

programme.title: Saab 93 e Saab 99 Turbo

programme.title: Supercars

programme.desc: Desde os anos 50, o Mercedes SL é considerado a lenda dos carros esportivos. Desde a lendária série 300SL, a série SL tem sido toda sobre inovação e esportividade. SL é a abreviação alemã de Super Leicht - super leve. Hoje a abreviação significa mais super luxo. No entanto, cada modelo estabeleceu a referência para o projeto e a inovação técnica.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o ícone de todos os sedãs e descapotáveis esportivos. Nenhum outro carro representa o estilo de vida dos anos 60 como o Ford Mustang. Com seu design muito especial e motor potente, o Mustang conquistou os corações de milhões de entusiastas de automóveis. A História do Automóvel mostrará a história do Ford Mustang, do primeiro protótipo ao mais recente Mustang Shelby com mais de 500 hp.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

A História do Automóvel mostra toda a grande história do Mini, desde o Mini original até o Rally-Mini de hoje.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship

A História do Automóvel conta a história do Carocha indestrutível, desde o primeiro modelo de 24,5 cv até o último modelo do Novo Carocha.

programme.title: An Bord des Mclaren 570S Spider

programme.desc: Qual é o carro de inverno perfeito para a diversão final na neve? A BMW X6 M e a Lada Niva têm que se provar no Vale Ulten no sul do Tirol, na Itália. Mais: Alta velocidade, adrenalina e pura ação na feira Snow Mobile, na Áustria.

programme.title: VW Tayron: Noch ein SUV von Volkswagen? | „langer Tiguan“ im Platz-Test | Motorvision
programme.desc: Er ist der Nachfolger vom Tiguan Allspace, bekommt aber einen neuen eigenen Namen: Tayron. Macht ihn das zur besseren Alternative für Familien? Wir checken Platz, Antriebe, Wettbewerber und vieles mehr.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: A busca pelo carro de inverno perfeito ainda está em andamento. Patrick Simons coloca o Subaru WRX STI e o Audi RS6 Clubsport da MTM ao longo de seus passos. Mais: Com o MP4-12C, a McLaren traz para as ruas um sucessor de seu famoso modelo F1.

programme.title: Elektro-Hot Hatch mit Rallye-Genen: Alpine A290 im Test!
programme.desc: Alpine steht für Motorsport und Rallye-Erfolge. Und dieser Hot Hatch soll die Marken-DNA ins Elektrozeitalter überführen: die A290. Wir che-cken, wie gut das gelingt und beleuchten die legendäre Historie des französischen Herstellers.

programme.title: McLaren 675LT Spider
programme.desc: We enjoy a a test drive with the McLaren 675LT Spider on the island of Tenerife

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: O Volkswagen Jetta é um grande vendedor nos Estados Unidos. Com a sexta geração, a Volkswagen também quer que o modelo tenha sucesso junto aos compradores de automóveis europeus. E mais: damos uma olhada no novo Ford Focus e no BMX X3.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Allrad macht nur im Gelände Spaß? Keineswegs! Und diese zwei sind der Beweis: Wir checken den neuen Subaru Forester on- und offroad. Und: Diese Allrad-Knallbüchse ist wohl eines der außergewöhnlichsten E-Autos. Fünf Fakten zum Hyundai Ioniq 5 N.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Patrick Simon analisa o Porsche Cayenne S Hybrid. Abaixo de seu capô há um motor V6 de 333 HP e um motor elétrico de 47 cavalos de potência. Além disso: o próximo piloto de corridas Chris Bauer no Campeonato FIA GT1 no Nürburgring.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Sand, Geröll, Wasser oder Asphalt – Abenteuer gibt es auf jedem Untergrund – wenn man das passende Gefährt hat. Wir testen die ultimativen Fun-Geräte Can-Am Outlander und Maverick R in Portugal und verraten spannende Facts zum Smart #5.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: O piloto de testes Patrick Simon quer participar das 24 Horas de Le Mans e revisa seu carro LMPC. Mais: comparamos o Volkswagen Tiguan 2.0 TDI com o Kia Sportage 2.0 CRDI.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.sub-title: Elektrische G-Klasse und CLA auf dem Timmelsjoch
programme.desc: Wir jagen den Mercedes G 580 EQ auf die verschneite Timmelsjoch Hochalpenstraße und klären alle Vor- und Nachteile des neuen elektrischen Antriebs. Außerdem fahren wir exklusiv im neuen noch getarnten CLA.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Como há telespectadores que não estão muito interessados no tema dos carros esportivos. Por essa razão, colocamos o foco deste episódio em carros pequenos.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Rallye-Feeling für die Straße. Der Audi Q8 e-tron edition Dakar ist auf 1000 Stück begrenzt und bietet mit 300 kW genug Leistung für Offroad-Abenteuer. Und: Der Porsche Cayenne Turbo E-Hybrid mit GT-Paket bietet Sportwagen-Power im SUV-Format.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: O Ruf RT35 pode parecer-se com um Porsche, mas não é. Desde 1981, a empresa Ruf de Pfaffhausen (Alemanha) é reconhecida como um fabricante independente. No entanto, a base para os veículos provém exclusivamente da Porsche.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Fomos a uma corrida de Fórmula E em Paris e conduzimos um modelo da sub-marca DS da Citroën que tenta colocar os pés neste segmento de corrida. Também: Peugeot Rifter e Citroën Berlingo compartilham a mesma plataforma. E: o facelift do Peugeot 508.

programme.title: 4x4 - Das Allrad Magazin
programme.desc: Ein Sportwagen, der auch vor Offroad-Strecken nicht zurückschreckt. Wir testen den Porsche 911 Dakar in einem Steinbruch. Und: Subaru setzt jetzt auch auf Elektroantrieb. Wie gut schlägt sich der Solterra auf der Straße und im Gelände?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Ansiosa para superar os danos à imagem da Volkswagen após o escândalo do diesel, a empresa introduziu uma gama de novos modelos. Ficamos atrás do volante do T-Cross em uma tração coberta. Também: um primeiro olhar sobre os modelos A1 e A6 da Audi.

programme.title: Book by Cadillac: Escalade, Corvette & Co im Auto-Abo fahren
programme.desc: Luxuskarossen wechseln, wie die Unterhose. Auto-Abo-Modelle sprießen derzeit aus dem Boden. Jüngster Vertreter: Book by Cadillac. Alle Autos der Marken Cadillac und Chevrolet zum festen Monatspreis von 1500 Euro. Versicherung, Steuern, Service - alles inklusive. Nur den Sprit muss der Kunde noch selbst bezahlen. Warum der hohe Preis trotzdem fair ist!

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: Rally Coromandel führt die NZRC auf spektakuläre Küsten-Schotterstraßen, wo Tempo, Präzision und Konstanz zählen. Im heißen Titelkampf entscheidet jede Prüfung und jede Sekunde in diesem intensiven Saisonmittelpunkt.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: O Ford Mustang normalmente tem um motor V8 ruidoso, mas o 2.3 EcoBoost depende do downsizing. Nós comparamos o turbo de 4 cilindros com o 430i da BMW. Também: Lada assume Dacia com seu Vesta SW. E: Opel Grandland X, SUV sem tração nas quatro rodas.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: O Stinger é o modelo mais dinâmico visualmente da Kia até agora, mas será que o cupê esportivo sul-coreano é capaz de convencer em nosso teste? Também: Exploramos seu Subaru XV. E: o Hyundai i30N é um concorrente digno do Volksawagen Golf GTI?

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: Die Rally Bay of Plenty liefert packende NZRC-Action, während Top-Teams auf anspruchsvollen Schotterstrecken um Punkte kämpfen. Tempo, Technik und Wendungen bestimmen das Geschehen auf dem Weg zum Saisonhöhepunkt.

programme.title: Ford GT40 - Project 'Victory in Le Mans'
programme.desc: Com seus carros V8, a Ford mostrou que eles foram capazes de construir vencedores de corrida. O Ford GT40 foi um excelente exemplo para isso, especialmente em Le Mans.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: O Mustang celebra seu 50º aniversário na pista de Las Vegas e Marco decide participar deste evento especial. Ele também verá a Shelby Cobras sendo construída exclusivamente para clientes em todo o mundo.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Na Califórnia, geralmente é tudo sobre a potência e o tamanho do motor. O carro esporte híbrido BMW i8 combina esses valores com o pensamento verde e define tendências ambientais. Como os ventiladores de gasolina reagem a um carro tão futurista?

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: Die International Rally of Whangarei bringt die NZRC-Saison 2025 zu einem spannenden Finale. Auf Weltklasse-Schotter kämpfen die besten Teams um den Sieg und die Chance, sich in einem dramatischen Saisonabschluss den Titel zu sichern.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: A alemã Kati é uma entusiasta americana de automóveis. Junto com seu namorado Patrick, ela realizou seu sonho e comprou um Chevy Chevelle de 1972. A raridade foi descoberta por Frank Slopianka e sua empresa "Special Cars Berlin" nos EUA.

programme.title: Mercedes-AMG GT S Performmaster
programme.desc: Não muito longe de Stuttgart está a casa do afinador Performmaster, especializado na otimização do desempenho dos modelos Mercedes-AMG. Eles transformaram o já mais que potente carro esportivo GT S em uma fera.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Chevrolet Corvair
programme.desc: Apesar de um número de produção de quase 1,4 milhões de unidades, o Chevrolet Corvair é praticamente desconhecido na Europa. Ele era inovador, eficiente, moderno e barato. No entanto, foi caluniado, despedaçado e mais tarde insultado.

programme.title: Crash
programme.sub-title: Mamas lasst eure Babys keine Rallyefahrer werden
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo
programme.desc: We take out the Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo for a couple of rounds

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Este Mitsubishi Outlander Plug-In Hybrid é o primeiro SUV híbrido do mundo com dois motores elétricos e um motor de combustão de 2 litros. Testamos se tal combinação faz sentido para veículos fora-de-estrada. Também: o Chevrolet Silverado é um pickup americano de tamanho normal com um V8 e um consumo médio de pelo menos 15 litros. Mas este modelo pode realmente economizar dinheiro com seu acionamento a gás natural.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Warum sollten sich Coupé-Fans für einen klassischen Zweitürer wie den Mercedes-Benz E400 statt für den großen Bruder, den CLS mit vier Türen, entscheiden? Und: hat der Volkswagen Arteon eine Chance gegen den Mercedes CLS?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Wir untersuchen den Unterschied zwischen dem Porsche 718 Cayman GTS und dem deutlich teureren 911 GTS. Außerdem: die dritte Generation des Mini als Cabrio. Und: Roadster- und Cabrio-Feeling mit dem Facelift des Fiat 124 Spider.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Antes de a Bentley e a Jaguar começarem a produzir seus próprios modelos de SUV de luxo, as duas marcas britânicas apresentavam sua oferta especial de carros. Demos uma olhada em seus carros conceito, o Bentley EXP 9F e o C-X17 da Jaguar. Também: como os fabricantes japoneses como Toyota, Nissan ou Subaru viram o futuro do SUV? E: O carro-conceito Unimog da Mercedes-Benz.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: Vive la France - das Franzosen Special
programme.desc: Wir durften ein Auto von Citroens Untermarke DS fahren, die versucht, in der Formel E Fuß zu fassen: Citroen und Peugeot teilen sich mit ihren Modellen Rifter und Berlingo die gleiche Plattform. Und: das Facelift des 508, des Flaggschiffs von Peugeot.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Os SUVs Nissan X-Trail e BMW X4 certamente não são típicos de veículos offroad. Testemunhamos a apresentação da Nissan de seu novo modelo X-Trail e a estréia mundial da BMW X4 em Bilbao. Também: o Troféu Steinbeißer, onde veículos off-road loucos participam de um emocionante e exigente rally.

programme.title: BMW M3 Test Drive - A BMW de maior sucesso de todos os tempos!
programme.desc: Nos anos 80, a BMW lançou um carro que tinha verdadeiros genes de corrida, o M3. Originalmente concebido como modelo de homologação para o Campeonato Alemão de Carros de Turismo, tornou-se num dos carros desportivos de estrada mais quentes do mundo.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Um den Imageschaden des Dieselskandals zu überwinden, gewährte Volkswagen exklusive Einblicke in zukünftige Entwicklungen. Wir gingen mit dem T-Cross auf verdeckte Fahrt. Außerdem: ein erster Blick auf Audis neue A1 und A6 Modelle.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: Com a Bentley Bentayga, a tradicional marca britânica está entrando no segmento de mercado que mais cresce. Este primeiro SUV de luxo do mundo é um conglomerado de superlativos sobre rodas.

programme.title: Volvo XC60 - O sueco cool
programme.desc: A paisagem sueca é caracterizada por montanhas, florestas e estradas solitárias. Ideal para este off-roader. O Volvo XC60 pontua com muitas características de segurança e uma aparência fresca.

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: Destaques do Central Machine Hire Rally Otago, com Ben Hunt enfrentando Robbie e Jack Stokes na abertura do NZRC. Com Emma Gilmore, bastidores do parque de serviço, análise especializada e ação espetacular no cascalho.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Wir vergleichen den Ford Mustang 2.3 EcoBoost turbo mit dem 430i von BMW mit ähnlichen Spezifikationen. Außerdem: Lada fordert mit dem Vesta SW Kombi Dacia heraus. Und: Der Grandland X von Opel ist ein SUV ohne Allradantrieb.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Kann der optisch aufregende Kia Stinger in unserem Test überzeugen? Außerdem: wir versuchen herauszufinden wie Subarus Boxermotor-Konzept im XV funktioniert. Und: der Hyundai i30N und der Volkswagen Golf GTI im Vergleich.

programme.title: Defender Trophy: Offroad-Check mit dem Sondermodell und alle Facts zur neuen Challenge!
programme.desc: Defender Trophy! So heißen die neue Extrem-Abenteuer-Challenge und das Sondermodell von Land Rover. Wir checken, was der spezielle Offroader „Defender 110 Trophy Edition“ im Gelände draufhat, und verraten alle Facts zum neuen globalen Wettbewerb.

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: Destaques do South Canterbury Rally em Timaru, onde Ben Hunt vence após trechos rápidos na floresta e drama mecânico. Com Darren Galbraith, bastidores de equipe, ação histórica e desafios para comentaristas do NZRC.

programme.title: Die Schöne und das Biest in einem: Der Aston Martin Vanquish Volante (2025)
programme.desc: Zeitlos elegantes Design und kräftige Motoren. Das ist Aston Martins Geheimrezept für den Aufschwung. Nach Absatzeinbrüchen und roten Zahlen müssen die Briten wieder Boden gut machen. Der Vanquish Volante tritt an gegen den Ferrari 12Cilindri Spider.

programme.title: Der Weg zum eigenen Porsche 911er | Experte Michael Schnabl verrät Tipps und Tricks
programme.desc: Welcher Sportwagenfan träumt nicht insgeheim von einem Porsche 911. Es ist DER Sportwagen aus Deutschland. Kompakt, ikonisch und vor allem wertstabil. Motorlegenden macht Autoträume war. Sein Spezialgebiet: seltene und sündhaft teure Porsche.

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: O Lone Star Rally Canterbury traz ação rápida no cascalho, com os melhores pilotos da Nova Zelândia lutando por pontos importantes. Duelos intensos, mudanças nas condições e pressão marcam a terceira etapa de 2025.

programme.title: Elektromotorräder Can-Am Pulse und Origin im Test und Europas erstes E-Motorrad-Festival in Berlin!
programme.desc: Elektromotorräder machen keinen Spaß? Wir testen, ob das stimmt mit den neusten Modellen von Can-Am, Pulse und Origin, und besuchen das Reload.Land, Europas erstes Elektro-Motorrad-Festival in Berlin.

programme.title: Faszination Mercedes S-Klasse: Wir fahren alle Baureihen vom 450 SEL 6.9 bis zum S 580 e!
programme.desc: Die Mercedes S-Klasse steht seit 7 Generationen für Komfort, Luxus und herausragende Technologie wie keine andere Limousine. Wir fahren alle Baureihen, vom 450 SEL 6.9 bis zum aktuellen S 580 e und ergründen die Faszination jedes Modells.

programme.title: A bordo da McLaren 570 GT
programme.desc: A bordo da McLaren 570 GT na ilha de Tenerife

programme.title: 1920: Die letzte Schlacht
programme.desc: Im August 1920 kommt es vor den Toren Warschaus zu einer Schlacht, die den Lauf der europäischen Geschichte für alle Zeiten prägen wird: Es herrscht Krieg zwischen Polen und Russland, die Rote Armee marschiert unaufhaltsam auf die Hauptstadt zu. Nur ein Wunder kann die Niederlage der polnischen Streitkräfte abwenden.

programme.title: Grand Piano - Symphonie der Angst
programme.desc: Die Angst spielt mit, als sich Starpianist Tom Selznick (Elijah Wood) nach einer fünfjährigen Pause wieder an den Konzertflügel setzt. Seinem ehemaligen Lehrer zu Ehren will der unter schwerem Lampenfieber leidende Künstler das 'Unspielbare Stück' aufführen, eine Komposition, die noch kein Pianist fehlerfrei aufführen konnte. Tom hingegen darf gar nicht anders: Eine geheimnisvolle Notiz zwischen den Noten droht ihm mit dem Tod, sollte er nur einmal den falschen Ton treffen...

programme.title: Weltnaturerbe Panama: La Amistad Nationalpark
programme.desc: Die Doku-Serie Weltnaturerbe Mittelamerika bringt Sie in diesem Teil nach Panama und Costa Rica. Genau genommen in den La Amistad Nationalpark, der zwischen den beiden tropischen Ländern beheimatet ist. Das 4.188 Quadratkilometer große Naturschutzgebiet besteht überwiegend aus uraltem Regen- und Nebelwald. 263 Arten von Amphibien und Reptilien wurden bisher entdeckt, die Mehrzahl davon Echsen.

programme.title: Europa Report
programme.desc: Eine internationale Besatzung von Astronauten unternimmt eine privat finanzierte Mission, um auf Jupiters viertgrößtem Mond nach Leben zu suchen.

programme.title: Voice from the stone
programme.desc: Es spielt in der Toskana der 1950er Jahre und ist die eindringliche und spannende Geschichte von Verena, einer feierlichen Krankenschwester, die einem kleinen Jungen helfen will, der seit dem plötzlichen Tod seiner Mutter verstummt ist.

programme.title: Ein Trauzeuge zum Verlieben
programme.desc: Die smarte Olivia Owens (Cristina Rosato), Managerin eines gemeinnützigen Gartenprojektes, gerät eines Tages mit Bauleiter Brian Wolf (Greyston Holt) aneinander, als dieser neben ihrem Grundstück eine Werbetafel für einen Wohnungsbau in die Erde schlägt, der Olivias grüne Ambitionen ernsthaft bedroht. Und als wäre das noch nicht genug, findet sich Olivia kurze Zeit später nicht nur neben Brian in einer engen Sitzreihe im Bus wieder, sondern muss auch noch feststellen, dass der anstrengende Kerl zur selben Hochzeit eingeladen ist wie sie! Schlimmer noch, während sich Olivia als Brautjungfer für ihre Freundin Jenny (Rebecca Olson) ins Zeug legt, springt Brian dem zukünftigen Bräutigam Richard (Matt Hamilton) als Trauzeuge zur Seite. Leider hat das Hochzeitspaar durchaus ein paar eigene Probleme, und bevor das so wunderschön geplante Wochenende endgültig ins Chaos zu stürzen droht, müssen sich Olivia und Brian wohl oder übel zusammenraufen, um die Hochzeit zu retten. Und so beginnt eine Party, die keiner von ihnen so schnell vergessen wird...

programme.title: Gefühl und Verführung
programme.desc: Als sie 15 war, besuchte die hübsche, aber unbedarfte Lucy Harmon (Liv Tyler) zum ersten Mal die Toskana - dort, wo ihre Mutter einst ein glückliches Leben führte und die männliche Bevölkerung verzauberte. Vier Jahre später, nach dem Selbstmord ihrer Mutter, kehrt Lucy in das kleine Dorf zurück. Sie will Gedichte schreiben, mehr über ihre Familiengeschichte erfahren und einen Jungen wiedersehen, den sie einst geküsst hat. Mit ihrer unbeschwerten und offenen Art reißt sie die Bewohner aus ihrer Lethargie. Nicht nur auf den leukämiekranken Schriftsteller Alex (Jeremy Irons) wirkt die bezaubernde Lucy wie ein wiederbelebendes Mittel.

programme.title: Cassandras Traum
programme.desc: Zwei Brüder. Ein Geheimnis. Kein Zurück. Terry und Ian wachsen im Londoner Arbeitermilieu auf – doch ihre Träume könnten unterschiedlicher nicht sein. Während Terry dem Rausch des Glücksspiels verfällt, sehnt sich Ian nach Aufstieg, Erfolg und einem Leben an der Seite der faszinierenden Schauspielerin Angela Stark (Hayley Atwell). Als beide finanziell am Abgrund stehen, bietet sich ihnen ein Ausweg: ein gefährlicher Deal, der ein dunkles Familiengeheimnis ans Licht bringt. Was als Rettung erscheint, wird zum moralischen Albtraum. In einer Welt, in der Loyalität zur Waffe wird und Schuld tiefer schneidet als jede Tat, geraten die Brüder in einen Strudel aus Verlangen, Verrat und Verzweiflung. Wie weit würdest du gehen, um deinen Traum zu retten – und was bleibt von dir, wenn du ihn erreichst?

programme.title: The Legend of Gobi
programme.desc: Vor langer Zeit gab es ein Königreich mit Menschen, die die Musik liebten. Ein königlicher Offizier mit dem Namen Ilger übernimmt die Macht, und ernennt sich selbst zum neuen König. Nach der Machtübernahme lässt er alle Musikinstrumente verbrennen und alle Musiker töten; nur ein Geiger namens Khuguljirgen überlebt. Obwohl der neue König allmächtig scheint, hat er keinen Thronerben. Aus diesem Grund lässt er die Prinzessin Egeerel entführen und in seinen Palast bringen. Mit der Ankunft der Prinzessin beginnen jedoch unerwartete Ereignisse…

programme.title: The Jacket
programme.desc: Jack Starks (Adrien Brody) bekommt im Golfkrieg eine Kugel in den Kopf und wird nach Hause geschickt. Aufgrund des traumatischen Erlebnisses leidet er unter Amnesie. Zurück in der Heimat wird er plötzlich mit einem Mord an einem Cop in Verbindung gebracht, an den er sich jedoch nicht erinnern kann. Um aufzuklären, was wirklich geschah, wird er in eine Nervenheilanstalt eingewiesen und mit schweren Psychopharmaka behandelt. Dort ist er den experimentellen Methoden von Dr. Becker (Kris Kristofferson) hilflos ausgeliefert. Der sperrt ihn in eine Zwangsjacke, verpackt in einen Leichenschrank. Starks hyperventiliert, hat albtraumhafte Visionen, die ihm seinen baldigen Tod offenbaren und kann in die Zukunft reisen. Fieberhaft versucht er nun, das Geflecht aus Vergangenheit und Zukunft, aus Wahrheit und Fantasie zu entwirren und seinen Tod aufzuhalten...

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Tief im dunkelsten Herzen Afrikas, dem unerforschten Kongo, verbirgt sich das mysteriöse Geheimnis einer untergegangenen Stadt. Ihr Name: Zinj. Ein Ort voller uralter Macht und unermesslicher Reichtümer. Das amerikanische High-Tech-Unternehmen TraviCom wittert den Schatz und schickt eine achtköpfige Crew in den Dschungel. Die Satellitenübertragung zeigt: Sie haben Zinj gefunden. Doch dann verstummen die Stimmen. Nur Bilder des Grauens erreichen Amerika – zerschmetterte Ausrüstung, tote Körper, ein Massaker ohne Spuren des Täters. Danach: völlige Stille. Unter der Leitung der entschlossenen Technologieexpertin Dr. Karen Ross (Laura Linney) startet eine zweite Expedition. Mit an Bord: Primatologe Dr. Peter Elliot (Dylan Walsh), seine sprechende Gorilla-Dame Amy und der kampferprobte Captain Monroe Kelly (Ernie Hudson). Was sie erwartet, ist kein Schatz, sondern ein tödliches Geheimnis – eine Stadt, bewacht von uralten Hütern, in einem Land, das keine Gnade kennt.

programme.title: Dog Eat Dog
programme.desc: Drei Männer haben das Gefängnis hinter sich und versuchen, sich an ein Leben in Freiheit zu gewöhnen. Einen Ausrutscher dürfen sie sich nicht erlauben, denn auch der kleinste Verstoß gegen die kalifornischen Bewährungsauflagen würde sie wieder hinter Gitter bringen. Doch Troy (Nicolas Cage), Mad Dog (Willem Dafoe) und Diesel (Christopher Matthew Cook) wollen nach ihren eigenen Regeln leben. Troy, ein arrogantes Genie, träumt zwar von einem einfachen beschaulichen Leben, doch die Schatten der Vergangenheit lassen ihn nicht los. Diesel dagegen steht auf der Gehaltsliste der Mafia und verliert zunehmend das Interesse an seinem Vorstadt-Zuhause und seiner nörgelnden Frau. Und der unberechenbare Mad Dog schlittert von einer Katastrophe in die Nächste. Gemeinsam wollen die drei das perfekte Verbrechen durchziehen. Doch die Polizei ist ihnen dicht auf den Fersen...

programme.title: Norwegian Ninja
programme.desc: Arne Treholt ist der Leiter einer supergeheimen Truppe allmächtiger Ninja-Krieger, die zur Zeit des Kalten Krieges über die Sicherheit und Neutralität ihres Landes wacht. Auf ihrem Stützpunkt, einer Insel vor der norwegischen Küste, trainieren die Helden für den Ernstfall. Dieser tritt bald ein.

programme.title: Escape
programme.desc: Norwegen im finstersten Mittelalter: Der schwarze Tod macht auch vor der Familie der 19jährigen Stigne nicht Halt, als diese auf der Flucht zum Opfer der mörderischen Bande um die skrupellose Dagmar wird. Zwar gelingt dem Mädchen als einzige Überlebende bald die Flucht. Aber ihre Verfolger sind ebenso gnadenlos wie die unwirtliche Wildnis im hohen Norden.

programme.title: Elephant Song
programme.desc: A psychiatrist is drawn into an intricate mind game with a disturbed patient when a colleague goes missing.

programme.title: Woman in Gold
programme.desc: A woman battles the establishment to recover her family possessions that had been seized by Nazis during WWII.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: An Armenian man struggles to keep his family and loved ones safe from genocide by the Turkish army during WWI.

programme.title: Wonder Wheel
programme.desc: On Coney Island, a lifeguard tells the story of a middle-aged carousel operator and his beleaguered wife.

programme.title: Boy A
programme.desc: The story of Jack, newly released from serving a prison sentence for a violent crime he committed as a child.

programme.title: The Dresser

Durante una salida, un encuentro fortuito revela a Manuela la existencia del pasado oculto de su esposo, sembrando en ella la semilla de la duda. Mientras Marcelo enfrenta una crisis matrimonial severa, Manuela jura descubrir si esa misteriosa mujer aún es dueña de Ricardo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Maricela visita a Alejandro reclamando explicaciones por terminar con Rosalía. Arminda manipula a Carmen ofreciéndole dinero para alejarla de Blanca, pero ella se niega. Eustoquio lleva a Isaías ante Erasto, quien intriga contra Adolfo y le ofrece dinero para comprar el local de Consuelo. Erasto encuentra a Blanca y exige el divorcio; ella se niega, planeando heredar su fortuna. Adolfo intenta ayudar económicamente a Consuelo pero recibe su desprecio. Rosalía manipula a Adolfo para obligar a Alejandro a regresar con ella.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene llega a la casa de Leonardo para asistir a Rebeca por la fiebre que está sufriendo. Agustina se pone en su camino y le prohíbe la entrada, argumentando que Leonardo dijo explícitamente que no la dejara pasar nadie a Irene. Ella termina subiendo con el permiso de la señora Jimena. A Rebeca se le cura la fiebre por la alegría que le causa la presencia de Irene. Leonardo e Irene tienen un encontronazo en el que él intenta convencerla de que vuelva a su casa. Leo va a buscar a María Lucía para informarle que Oriana finalmente no está embarazada y para confesarle su amor. Julio, su hermano, se enfada con Leo e intenta impedir que hable a solas con María Lucía.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Aída quiere decirle algo muy importante a Sol y Reina se interpone. En ese momento llega Heriberto con la noticia de que Sol está libre por decisión del juez. Y le dice a Reina que él y Sol se van a vivir juntos. Maricielo encuentra a su padre infraganti en un bar con su amante. Ella pone el grito en el cielo y decide volver a vivir a lo de su madre junto a Torombolo, Bárbara y Eloycito. Ramón se opone rotundamente al casamiento entre Alicia y Carlucho.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Briggite monta en cólera en el consultorio del ginecólogo. No puede creer que esté menopáusica. Pero el doctor la quita del error. Es una etapa que finaliza pero otra comienza. El Doctor Caridad insulta a junior y le dice que si él no le dice a Jesica hoy que su esposa está embarazada | se lo dice él y que no quiere hablar más del matrimonio. Junior está feliz y pensando en regresar hoy mismo para su casa. ROKUro y Dionisia se despiden hasta una próxima vez.

programme.desc: La noticia del embarazo de Cristina causa revuelo y tanto Gladis como Rómulo están muy molestos con sus respectivos hijos. Después, muy molesto va Rómulo a casa de Gladis para enfrentar a Gerson y exigirle que se responsabilice de su nueva paternidad.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Virginia le confirma a su madre, Trinidad, de que va a trabajar en Ferrándiz. Trinidad no lo acepta de ninguna manera. Rebeca se cura gracias a la asistencia de Irene, que, a su vez se reconcilia con Leonardo. La señora Jimena se entera por su hijo que Virginia va a trabajar en la empresa, reniega de eso y va a solicitar un impedimento legal para que ella no se pueda acercar a su familia. Julio se pelea con su hermano Leonardo por causa del embarazo supuestamente falso de Oriana y le cuenta a su padre que Leonardo se reconcilió con María Lucía. Virginia se encuentra en la oficina con Rodrigo, alguien del pasado, que trata de abusar de ella. María Lucía, que se había reconciliado con Leonardo, queda desilusionada por la pelea que él tuvo con Ricardo.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: El doctor le entrega a Alejandro los resultados del examen de ADN que se hizo para determinar si era padre tanto del hijo de Aída como del de Sol. Ya que las pruebas que él leyó determinaban que el hijo de Sol no es suyo, él la visita para decirle que no quiere verla nunca más. Sol aprovecha este alejamiento de Alejandro para evitar tener problemas al confrontar a su madre. Pero le duele mucho eso ya que sabe que no es verdad, que él es el padre de su hijo y que Reina cambió las pruebas de ADN.

Eles são recrutados com um grupo de pequenos criminosos por Gerry “The Frenchman” Ouimette, o braço direito do chefe da máfia Providence, Raymond Patriarca. Patriarca é um notório gângster e matador que, embora esteja na prisão, continua administrando seu império do crime de dentro de sua cela bem equipada. A equipe realiza então o maior assalto da história americana: roubar mais de US$ 30 milhões do cofre de um negociante de peles que a Máfia usa como seu banco não oficial para armazenar dinheiro e bens roubados. programme.desc: Dois amigos de longa data, Deuce e Chucky, são especialistas em roubar lojas de penhores e joalherias e se envolvem em um plano para roubar um cofre da máfia. Eles são recrutados com um grupo de pequenos criminosos por Gerry “The Frenchman” Ouimette, o braço direito do chefe da máfia Providence, Raymond Patriarca. Patriarca é um notório gângster e matador que, embora esteja na prisão, continua administrando seu império do crime de dentro de sua cela bem equipada. A equipe realiza então o maior assalto da história americana: roubar mais de US$ 30 milhões do cofre de um negociante de peles que a Máfia usa como seu banco não oficial para armazenar dinheiro e bens roubados. Quando todas as pessoas que participaram do assalto começam a morrer, os dois amigos devem tentar se manter vivos para contar a história.

programme.title: Xeque-Mate
programme.desc: Slevin Kelevra (Josh Hartnett) está com vários problemas em sua vida. O prédio onde mora foi condenado, sua carteira de identidade foi roubada e ele recentemente flagrou sua namorada na cama com outro homem. Para escapar ao menos por algum tempo dos problemas, ele consegue emprestado com seu amigo Nick Fisher (Sam Jaeger) um apartamento em Nova York. Paralelamente um plano está sendo tramado no submundo do crime de Nova York. Para se vingar da morte de seu filho, o Chefe (Morgan Freeman) planeja um golpe no filho de seu arquiinimigo, o Rabino (Ben Kingsley). O Chefe contrata Goodkat (Bruce Willis) para executar o plano, que consiste em encontrar um apostador que deva muito dinheiro ao Chefe a ponto de aceitar matar o filho do Rabino para se livrar da dívida. O escolhido é Nick Fisher, o que faz com que Goodkat vá até seu apartamento e confunda Slevin com seu alvo.

programme.title: Vidas que se Cruzam

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Armored
programme.desc: Après la mort de ses parents, Ty rentre d'Irak où il était soldat pour s'occuper de son petit frère. Pour faire face aux factures, il accepte de travailler comme convoyeur de fonds pour la société qui employait son père. Au dernier jour de sa période d'essai, Ty se voit proposer par Cochrane, son chef d'équipe, de voler les 42 millions de dollars qu'ils doivent bientôt transporter. Le plan est aussi simple que génial : pas d'armes, pas de victimes, pas de violence, et aucune preuve... Toute l'équipe est dans le coup. D'abord réticent, Ty finit par accepter. Le jour J, le plan se déroule sans accrocs, jusqu'à ce qu'un imprévu fasse tout déraper...

Mais quand leurs fantasmes les plus fous se transforment en véritables cauchemars, les invités n’ont d’autre choix que de résoudre les mystères de cette île pour espérer en sortir vivants…

programme.title: Bienvenue Dans La Jungle

Cependant après l'avoir retrouvé, le chasseur de primes va s'unir à lui pour combattre Hatcher, le gérant cruel et véreux d'une mine d'or. Les choses vont encore se compliquer lorsque les deux hommes vont tous deux s'éprendre de la belle Mariana.

programme.title: A L'aube Du 6eme Jour

Plongé dans un monde sinistre de meurtre, de corruption et de tromperie high-tech, il est arraché à sa famille par des malfrats qui ont été envoyés pour le détruire. Adam doit non seulement sauver sa vie mais également découvrir qui est derrière ce complot diabolique afin de retrouver sa famille et son identité.

programme.title: Chappie

Au moment où il rencontre Teri, une jeune fille sous le contrôle de gangsters russes violents, il décide d'agir. McCall sort ainsi de sa retraite et voit son désir de justice réveillé.

Dirigée par un certain Yorgi, celle-ci se fait appeler 'Anarchie 99' et son siège se situe à Prague, en République tchèque.

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Highlander: The Animated Series
programme.desc: A flashback shows the death of Connor MacLeod at Kortan's hand during the Jettator ceremony.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Cooking on the Edge of the World | Tasting the Wild Food of Newfoundland"
programme.desc: In Newfoundland, the rhythm of life is dictated by survival. It’s a rugged existence, but the DIRT crew discovered it breeds a wild, abundant kinship. Their guide, chef Jeremy Charles, turned Newfoundland’s raw ingredients into world-class cuisine. He took them out to stock up his way—with fishing poles, shotguns, and foraging baskets. That resourcefulness fueled a final feast of everything from moose tongue to fresh urchin, served at a classic Newfoundland “shed party.”

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting rural communities that rely on the yearly cycle of wild game harvest.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest. The experience comes full circle when the meat from these animals is donated to local schoolchildren, who receive not only fresh meals but also school supplies and sweets that light up the village.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny meets up with a local rally cars fabricator who takes him fishing. Ryan and his kids show Danny a thing or two about trolling on the lake.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.sub-title: "Alaska's Massive Marvels: A Boating Expedition through America's Last Frontier Pt 2
programme.desc: From battling towering 12-foot waves in the Gulf of Alaska, to reeling in colossal 200 lb. halibut, they discover firsthand the rugged beauty of America's 49th state. This episode highlights Lindell Yachts as a top builder of rugged offshore sportfishing yachts, as well as Radon Boats as great pilothouse fishing and guide boats.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael continues the family tradition of fish stew and gathering, with hopes that Larkin will pass on the same traditions.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Capt. Josh heads offshore with Marcus Castro for a day of fishing, hoping to reel in the perfect catch for tonight’s family dinner.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: "Could Bull Sharks Survive In The Great Lakes"
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: "Are Dinosaurs Still Alive In The African Congo?"
programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Capt Josh and Johnny from Johnny Jigs head out with gorgeous weather on their side to hit some reefs and put the jigs to work!

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Captain Josh and the fam head out to do some surf fishing to see what’s biting. Then ended the day building professional sand castles and playing goofy golf.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: The bite’s dead during a neap tide, but Josh and Isaiah don’t back down. Watch them adapt, pivot, and turn a tough day into a hard-earned win. It’s not luck—it’s hustle.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Josh and Alex explore the SS United States; the world‘s largest artificial reef.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff venture deep into Maine’s backcountry with their buddy Chuck, ice fishing remote lakes only reachable by snowmobile. Their journey ends at the legendary “ghost trains,” a pair of abandoned locomotives that now rest as silent monuments to a forgotten logging era.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the elusive Coues deer, known to hunters as the “Grey Ghost.” Through scorching sun and shifting winds, they test their skill and patience chasing one of North America’s most elusive big game animals.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way team continue their African journey with hunts for both the majestic Kudu and elusive Golden Wildebeest. The experience comes full circle when the meat from these animals is donated to local schoolchildren, who receive not only fresh meals but also school supplies and sweets that light up the village.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson on an epic hunting adventure in the stunning landscapes of New Zealand as he goes after Whitetail deer. On this hunt, Mark was unable to get his firearms import permit in time to take his Gunwerks rifle, so he'd have to borrow a trusty rifle from his guide, Shawn. Get ready for heart-pounding action, breathtaking scenery, and valuable tips and tricks from a seasoned hunter.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Freak Show - Largest Buck I’ve Ever Encountered"
programme.desc: The hunt for FREAK SHOW became a thrilling adventure after I spotted him on Cabela’s trail cam. Having hunted Kentucky for over a decade and established my own properties—Bootleggers Ridge and Stonewall Plantation—I was eager for the chance at such a remarkable deer. Despite having drawn a coveted caribou tag through Worldwide Trophy Adventures’ TAGS Program, the allure of FREAK SHOW was too strong to resist. After careful planning and waiting for the right wind, I finally - set out on September 11. With my crossbow in hand, I waited anxiously in the stand, my heart racing as the shadows lengthened. Just when I thought the evening might end without a sighting, a movement caught my eye, sending my pulse soaring. With caution, FREAK SHOW appeared.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "North American Deer Slam - Mexican Central Plateau Whitetail"
programme.desc: Mark Peterson continues his journey toward the North America Deer Slam — this time deep in the rugged mountains of North Central Mexico. In pursuit of one of the smallest and rarest Whitetail subspecies, the elusive Mexican Central Plateau Whitetail, Mark faces harsh terrain, high elevations, and the challenge of locating a deer that few hunters have ever seen, let alone taken.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: Upland Slam - "Hungarian Partridge, Wyoming Day 3: - A Bird Hunters Diary"
programme.desc: In Part 3, Day 3, Mark Peterson wraps up his time in Wyoming upland hunting with an epic partridge hunt. Does he run into some chukars along the way? Take a look inside this episode to find out!

programme.title: The Bearded Buck
programme.desc: The Sharp brothers have never really been known for their turkey hunting success. But now, they're showing us just how easy it can be with some hard work and a solid game plan. They say "even a blind squirrel finds a nut"… but at what point is it no longer luck?

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this adventure, we tag along with the Disabled American Veterans of Minnesota "Outdoor Programs" as they travel to Texas for a Hog hunt. We also honor our next Wichita Kansas Scheels Hometown Hero, Will Rivera!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this adventure, we travel to Sioux Narrows Ontario Canada for a week long trip with Time on the Water to Lake of the Woods. In this episode we share the stories of Vietnam Veteran Leon Merhkens, fire fighters Jeff Benson/Seth Beyer and founder/CEO of Time on the Water, Chris Hansen. In addition, the fishing is pretty good too! We also highlight Iowa City Scheels Hometown hero Nic Pruter.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Vietnam war veteran Don Weber recounts his amazing journey through survivors guilt, PTSD and starting over.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Carlos Powell tells of family sacrifice and fighting his post service “demons.”

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This one is special. We took Ron aka “Don”, a WoodHaven employee who helps assemble our pot calls, out to Tennessee for a turkey hunt he’ll never forget. After 35 years of not harvesting a Turkey, Don finally gets his shot.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Some mornings just remind you why we do this. We found ourselves in Southwest Alabama on one of the prettiest mornings a turkey hunter could ever ask for — cool air, soft light breaking through the timber, and gobbles echoing through the hardwoods. Even better, we got to share it with a great friend, and that’s what makes hunts like this truly special. This is what turkey hunting is all about — good friends, beautiful mornings, and chasing longbeards in God’s country.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This Kentucky trip is one we’ll be talking about for a long time. Three longbeards hit the ground, but honestly, it’s the time spent in the woods with good friends that made this hunt what it was. We had birds gobbling, lots of laughs, and a memories that will last a lifetime, and that’s what makes turkey hunting so addicting. These are the kind of hunts you don’t take for granted.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Four minutes. That’s all we had left before cutoff time and somehow, it all came together. After a tough morning hunt in the Illinois woods, everything changed in the final moments. We finally got a longbeard to commit, and we made it count just before time ran out. This is one of those hunts that reminds you why we do it.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Colten & Mark Scroggins is in Oklahoma during the peak rut, chasing mature whitetail bucks! With bucks on the move and searching for does, it's the perfect time to break out the calls. Watch as Mark and Colten pull out all the stops—getting aggressively loud with the WoodHaven "Intimidator" Grunt Call—to turn a cruising buck and bring him right into bow range at the blind.

programme.desc: Welcome to The Fly Shop Tour! In September of 2022, we set across the Rocky Mountains on a 2500 Mile Road Trip visiting & fishing with local Fly Shops. Our Mission? To highlight small businesses that drive the sport we love: Fly Fishing! programme.desc: In this exciting episode, we venture out onto Porcupine Lake for some beautiful walleye action with Craig Salmonson from Timmins Angling Adventures. Patience was key as we waited for a break in challenging weather conditions—but it all paid off with an unforgettable day on the water. Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.
